_note: Height-aware pagination must keep every ref and line total on the page. | pdf_pages went 5 -> 6 in 0.23.9. Its notes measure 57 cost units against a 53-unit page budget, so they now split across two pages. At 5 pages a subtotal row overlapped the footer border by 2px -- it fit, barely. The budget is deliberately conservative because the two failure modes are not equal: too loose clips content silently, too tight costs a visible page. We pay the page.
